profile.name: Heihachi
profile.overview: Heihachi is a rushdown Mishima-style character who excels at pressuring opponents and wearing down their defense with some of the strongest mid attacks in the game. His combo damage is extremely high, he has tremendous chip damage potential in Heat, and his new stance options grant amazing mixup opportunities. The classic Mishima staple moves such as Electric Wind God Fist and Flash Punch Combo (1,1,2) are as strong as ever, and his new i18 Indra's Kick (b+4) is a devastating long-range safe-on-block counter hit launcher. These tools grant him an extremely potent defensive capability that synergizes perfectly with his aggressive gameplan.
profile.playstyle: Classic Mishima rushdown. Use the Flash Punch Combo and Wind God Fist to punish, wavedash into Fujin (FUJ) and the hellsweep, and pressure with plus moves like f+4 and the Raijin stance. Heat builds Ultimate Counts towards Warrior Instinct (WAR). Wavu warns his generic pokes are linear and most lows are launch punishable.
strengths: Classic Mishima toolkit, such as wavedash, EWGF, hellsweep, Left/Right Splits Kick, and his iconic Flash Punch Combo as a i10 hit-confirmable wallsplat.
Explosive damage potential with great wall carry to boot
Powerful stance mixups, is not forced to use stance pressure in neutral to create opportunities
Warrior Instinct turns him into a boss character
f+1+2 becomes an i12 launch punish with Warrior Instinct, guaranteeing df+2,1 as a tornado follow-up
Heaven's Merciless Wrath (b+1+2) Heat Engager parry has lots of utility, works against most mid/high kicks and punches, active from frames 5~25
weaknesses: Generic pokes are worse than other Mishimas, with linearity and bad frame data being the main culprits
Most lows are launch punishable, with below average damage or frame advantage on hit
Moves that enter stance (f+3, f+4, 1,b+2) have high coverage option selects when blocked, with downjab/generic d+4 beating almost all options
Relies entirely on Heat to access Warrior Instinct, making Heat usage more predictable
Requires good execution to get the most out of punish opportunities

stances.name: Wind God Step
stances.note: Mishima crouch dash: Wind God Fist and Thunder God Fist come from here.

stances.name: Fujin
stances.entry: d+1+2, or D after f+3, f+4
stances.note: FUJ.1,1 is a Heat Engager; FUJ.2 (Hidden Wind God Fist) tornadoes. In Heat, Fujin auto-parries mids and highs (Wavu).

stances.name: Raijin
stances.note: RAI.2 is a homing high that guard-breaks and is +10 on block.

stances.name: Warrior Instinct
stances.entry: 1+4, or three Ultimate Counts in Heat
stances.note: Powers up moves: df+2,WAR.1 tornadoes, WAR.f,F+2 has more range.

heat: Gain one Ultimate Count per heat activation
Enter WAR (Warrior Instinct) after gaining three stacks
Auto-parry mids and highs from FUJ stance

keyMoves.summary: Flash Punch Combo-style i10 string, -12 on block if all three finish.
keyMoves.purpose: His i10 punish that can be hit-confirmed.
keyMoves.afterBlock: -12 when the whole string is blocked.

keyMoves.summary: Demon Breath: i12 mid, -10 on block, launches on hit (+24a).
Chrome Dome: i12 high headbutt, -14 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: An i12 punisher that leads to a follow-up launch in Heat or Warrior Instinct (Wavu).
keyMoves.gamePlan: Punish, then cash in with Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Wind God Fist: i11 high, -10 on block; becomes the EWGF in Heat (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Fast launch punisher and whiff punisher.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Practise the input until it is automatic.

keyMoves.summary: Raoh Thrust: i13 mid Heat Engager, -8 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A fast, safe mid that starts Heat.

keyMoves.summary: Ascension Upper: i15 tornado from crouch, -14 on block.
keyMoves.use: After blocking lows that are -15 or worse.

keyMoves.summary: Quick Iron Fist: i13 while-standing mid, -14 on block.
Right Splits Kick: i19 mid, +4 on block, can enter FUJ.
Lightning Crush: i18 knee, -5 on block, can enter FUJ.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe mid with a stance follow-up.

keyMoves.summary: Otoko Geri: i15 high, tornadoes on counter hit (+52a).
keyMoves.purpose: A CH launcher that can be charged.

keyMoves.summary: Sacred Tree Fell: i16 low, -13 on block.
keyMoves.gamePlan: Wavu: most of his lows are risky.

keyMoves.summary: Thunder Cutter: i17 homing high from Raijin, +10 on block.
keyMoves.use: From Raijin to keep the turn.

keyMoves.summary: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch on break.

combos.name: Launch BnB: 4 T! uf+3,4 1,b+2,4
combos.situation: After a regular launch such as f,F+3 (Left Splits Kick).
mistakes: Pressing 4 too late: it must hit before they fall.
